# assert

Raise an error if a condition is false.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `lua.assert` |
| Origin | Lua base |
| Category | Lua Base |
| Family | Function |
| Monaco kind | `function` |
| Format | `assert(condition, message)` |
| Valid contexts | `file`, `executable` |
| Autocomplete | `assert(condition, message)` |

## Example
